answer_1.quote: Learning a preference model for longform question answering can be formulated as a learning-to-rank problem. Given a question q and a set of candidate answers a1, a2, ..., an, the goal of the preference model is to find a partial ordering of the answers by training on pairs that best align with real human preferences.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate quality in a ranking setting by ordering human-written answers along the PM scores, and compute the MRR of the top-upvoted answer as well as NDCG.
